test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 7 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Two statements are followed by two conclusions numbered | and II. Assuming the statements to be true even if they do not conform to real-world knowledge, decide which of the conclusion(s) logically follows/follow from the statements. 

**Statements:**

1. All hostels are buildings.

2. Some buildings are palaces.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some palaces are hostels.

Il. No palace is a hostel.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Either conclusion I or II follows

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/964daf282f97f95cb08b01ddb2a682f48a34694bcaf86ded660fa7ca648873cf.png] Conclusions:

I. Some palaces are hostels → False (it is possible but not definite as shown in the diagram above)

Il. No palace is a hostel → False (it is possible but not definite as shown in the diagram above)

But, both these conclusions form complementary pairs.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**There are two complementary pairs:

(1) All - Some not

(2) No - Some

Hence, **either conclusion I or II follows.**
